Business Description: Capitalized balances and movements by P&L Grouping Client.
Business Grain: P&L Client + Capitalized Accounting Period
Notes: dp_deal_financials.capitalized_trial_balance_v is maintained at P&L Client, also referred to as Deal or P&L Grouping Client, and Capitalized Accounting Period grain. pnl_client_id represents the P&L Grouping Client identifier rather than an individual underlying Client identifier. Multiple individual Clients may roll up to the same P&L Grouping Client. Capitalized balances must therefore be interpreted and reported as Deal-level positions. Joining the view directly to Client-level records can repeat the same Deal balance once for each Client unless the Client data is first reduced to a compatible Deal-level grain. Client names should not be added to Deal-level capitalized-balance output unless a deliberate one-to-many presentation is required and the repeated balance risk is clearly controlled.

Business Description: Mechanical-product master view representing a licensed release or product managed in Tempo. The object combines the product identifier, UPC/EAN, title, artist, license and licensee references, license type and status, release and workflow dates, label, advance terms, units-sold information, controlled and collectable percentages, estimated collections, matching indicators, currency, audit attributes, and legacy life-to-date licensing measures. The supplied SQL selects directly from edw.tempo_mechanical_product and enriches descriptive office, licensee, and license-type attributes through LEFT JOINs without aggregation or row filtering.
